script.title: Call Option vs Put Option
script.caption_hook: Right to buy or right to sell? Call vs Put in one minute

lines.say: Ma'am, is an option the right to buy or to sell?
An option is a right, not a duty. A call is the right to buy. A put is the right to sell.

board.title: Call vs Put
board.sub: Right to buy or to sell

lines.say: So who pays for that right?
Buyer pays a premium, gets the right. Writer receives it, must perform if buyer exercises. That premium is the buyer's maximum loss.
Okay, but when does the call actually pay off?
At expiry, call payoff equals the maximum of spot price at expiry minus strike X, or zero.

board.title: Call at expiry
board.sub: S_T = spot at expiry, X = strike price

lines.say: So a put must be the opposite?
Yes. At expiry, put payoff equals the maximum of strike X minus spot price at expiry, or zero.

board.title: Put at expiry
board.sub: S_T = spot at expiry, X = strike price

lines.say: A call has strike ₹100, premium ₹5 per share. Spot at expiry is ₹120. Payoff ₹20, profit ₹15 per share.
A put with same strike ₹100, premium ₹5 per share. Spot at expiry ₹90: payoff ₹10, profit ₹5 per share.
Remember: call is the right to buy, put is the right to sell.
